title: Chicken
description: Database record: poultry · Coop Chicken Updated 2026-08-11 The best-documented animal in the current build. Buy from Angela, keep hay and water in the coop trough, mount the coop heater on the outside wall, and pet daily for a shot at large eggs. Buying & bringing home Buy chickens from Angela, the chicken seller NPC. After purchase they do not enter your backpack — they appear in the small fenced field behind her house. Grab them manually: carry them home one by one on foot, or load them into a car boot. Community-confirmed Steam thread "Chicken coop mission" (DJM, Yakiwi) In every documented case the coop-mission stuck point came from missing the post-purchase prompt; other bugs in this mission cannot be ruled out. Community-confirmed Steam thread "Chicken coop mission" (DJM, Yakiwi) · Community discussion scan archive (local file: community-scan-2026-08-08.md, 90 topics scanned, 44 read) Exact chicken purchase price is unverified. One player reported about 4,000+C for four chickens; treat as a lead only. Single-source Community discussion scan archive (local file: community-scan-2026-08-08.md, 90 topics scanned, 44 read) Housing & heater Chickens live in a coop. The heater and AC must be the coop/barn versions bought from Angela — the house decoration heater/AC sold at City Hall does nothing for coops. Official Steam thread "Can't sell roosters" (Jennoula, official) Mount the coop heater on the outside of the coop exterior wall. Community-confirmed Steam thread "How to add the heater" (maxitubby) · Steam thread "Hühnerstall Bug" (Kartesk, Jennoula) A fenced outdoor roaming area matters: chickens that can roam outside in an enclosed area get the chance to lay large eggs. Official Steam thread "About the chickens" (Jennoula, official) Chicks exist as the early growth stage of chickens; 2 additional rooster variations were added. Official · pre-EA documented The Ranchers, Ranching v2 update! (official Steam announcement) Feeding Chickens eat hay — they pick the grains out of hay/straw piles. Official Steam thread "Chicken Feed" (Jennoula, official) Two ways to feed: hold hay near the animal to hand-feed (raises the food reserve bar in its info tab), or fill the trough and animals eat by themselves once every morning, covering the whole day. Official Steam thread "Food and water reserves" (Mancer, Jennoula) General daily care: only the trough inside the coop needs filling — animals eat and drink inside before leaving in the morning, so outdoor troughs stay optional while the door is open. Official Steam thread "About the chickens" (Jennoula, official) Hay comes from cutting bushes or looting crates and barrels on NPC farms. Single-source Steam thread "where can i find hay" (Tila) Water Water is supplied through a trough; hand-feeding does not work for water — the water reserve bar only refills from a trough. Official Steam thread "Food and water reserves" (Mancer, Jennoula) For automated water, a water tower alone is not enough — you must sign a water contract with the mayor at City Hall, then the tower refills on its own. Community-confirmed Steam thread "Watertower problem" (Akhenatom, Mancer, Jennoula) · Games Station gameplay footage V0.8.10.455 (local archive: games-station.mp4, shelf scan 03:15–03:45) Eggs & meat Adult chickens with every need and satisfaction maxed start laying. Egg size (S/M/L) and whether an egg is fertile are RNG; hover an egg to check fertility. Large eggs are the rarest and require maxed needs plus happiness. Official Steam thread "Egg Hatching Question" (Jennoula, official; SUwUMaBUwU) Chicken Egg - Small retails at 60C on the Leafy Market shelf. This is a shop purchase price, not what your eggs sell for. Video-observed Games Station gameplay footage V0.8.10.455 (local archive: games-station.mp4, shelf scan 03:15–03:45) Chicken Breast and Chicken Leg exist as current-build shop items, confirming the meat path for culled chickens. Video-observed Games Station gameplay footage V0.8.10.455 (local archive: games-station.mp4, shelf scan 03:15–03:45) Meat, milk and eggs are species-specific items. Official · pre-EA documented The Ranchers, Ranching v2 update! (official Steam announcement) Breeding & hatching An egg-hatching mechanic for oviparous animals is documented. Official · pre-EA documented The Ranchers, Ranching v2 update! (official Steam announcement) Large eggs arrived only around the 4th-5th batch for one player — pure RNG; daily petting raises the animal rating and large eggs became noticeably more frequent. Community-confirmed Steam thread "Egg Hatching Question" (Jennoula, official; SUwUMaBUwU) · Steam thread on the Gigi egg quest (DJM, Bobthekiller and others) Sickness & the vet An animal sickness mechanic exists; the heater prevents temperature sickness but cannot cure an already sick animal. Official Steam thread "Can't sell roosters" (Jennoula, official) · The Ranchers, Ranching v2 update! (official Steam announcement) Take sick chickens to the veterinarian. The vet only treats animals that are actually sick — a famished (starving) animal is turned away. Single-source Steam thread "how to cure at the vet?" (Seansniper27, maxitubby) A famished chicken recovers by the next morning if you bring it back to the coop and feed it manually. Single-source Steam thread "how to cure at the vet?" (Seansniper27, maxitubby) There is no sickness notification system; check animals manually each day. Single-source Community discussion scan archive (local file: community-scan-2026-08-08.md, 90 topics scanned, 44 read) 1 item not yet verified — show Vet treatment cost is unpublished — nobody in the scanned threads gave a figure. Unknown Community discussion scan archive (local file: community-scan-2026-08-08.md, 90 topics scanned, 44 read) Feed automation chain Full chain: mount an Auto-Feeding Kit on the coop, build a Silo inside its range and load hay, build a Water Tower (its link radius is much smaller than the silo's), sign the water contract with the mayor, then pick food/water type on the coop trough and flip the switch — a green light confirms a correct setup. Official Steam thread "Does the automatic barn feeding kit work?" (gamingmarcel20, Jennoula) · Steam thread "Silos" (maxitubby, Jennoula) · Steam thread "Watertower problem" (Akhenatom, Mancer, Jennoula) Hovering buildings with the hammer equipped shows linkage; a silo displays how many auto-feeders connect to it, and linking happens automatically. Single-source Steam thread "Silos" (maxitubby, Jennoula) The water meter is on the phone, or on the wall at the far right end past the ranch gate. Single-source Steam thread "Watertower problem" (Akhenatom, Mancer, Jennoula) Most "auto feeder does nothing" reports trace back to a missing water contract or the water tower sitting outside link radius. Community-confirmed Steam thread "Does the automatic barn feeding kit work?" (gamingmarcel20, Jennoula) · Community discussion scan archive (local file: community-scan-2026-08-08.md, 90 topics scanned, 44 read) Quests The Gigi large-egg quest needs large eggs: pet chickens daily to raise their rating and use the Angela heater. Two large eggs are needed before the delivery point appears. Community-confirmed Steam thread on the Gigi egg quest (DJM, Bobthekiller and others) Daily care needs only the trough inside the coop — animals eat and drink there before leaving in the morning (official). What an outdoor area affects is large-egg chance: chickens that roam outside in an enclosed area get the chance to lay large eggs. There is no evidence that the Gigi quest requires an outdoor trough. Official Steam thread "About the chickens" (Jennoula, official) The chicken coop mission has no confirmed bug — bought chickens wait in the field behind Angela's house, and documented stuck cases trace back to the missed prompt. Community-confirmed Steam thread "Chicken coop mission" (DJM, Yakiwi) Disappearing-chicken checklist Hotfix 0.8.10.562 officially fixed several animal disappearance paths: entering a barn or coop at night, chicks growing up, newborn mammals spawning, animals appearing after a load, and animals becoming stuck between a barn or coop and its doors. Older reports and workarounds below are pre-0.8.10.562 context; only a reproduction on 0.8.10.562 or later should be treated as a current residual bug. Official Hotfix 0.8.10.562 — official Steam announcement Before 0.8.10.562, chickens submitted at the coop door could enter the stock count but vanish or get stuck inside the coop's exterior wall. The historical workaround was to walk inside before dropping them; stuck birds could sometimes be recovered by removing the others and demolishing the coop. Historical Steam thread on the coop-door chicken delivery bug (Big Grizzly) · Steam thread "Hühnerstall Bug" (Kartesk, Jennoula) · Hotfix 0.8.10.562 — official Steam announcement Check linking first: walking near the door should show a stock counter like 0/6 over the dark floor area — no counter means the coop is not linked. Official Steam thread "Hühnerstall Bug" (Kartesk, Jennoula) No fence plus an open door lets chickens wander off for good. Community-confirmed Community discussion scan archive (local file: community-scan-2026-08-08.md, 90 topics scanned, 44 read) Without the Angela heater/AC, chickens die from heat or cold stress. Community-confirmed Steam thread "Animals keep dying" (multiple players) Before 0.8.10.562, one player reported that reloading the save sometimes respawned a vanished chicken. Historical Steam thread "A temp chicken issue fix!" (LittleGhost and others) Selling & profit Selling live animals is not implemented. The official recommendation for surplus chickens and roosters is to dispatch them with an axe, pickaxe or weapon and sell the meat. The animal must be placed on the ground first — tools do not work while carrying it (that is intended, not a bug). Official Steam thread "Can't sell roosters" (Jennoula, official) One detailed profit report values an adult (10+ days) Legendary chicken at roughly 24,000C in meat (1× 9,000 meat + 2× 500 legs + 8× 1,750 breasts), with Legendary eggs at S 250 / M 375 / L 590; a second player puts an ordinary mature chicken at 5,000+C of meat. Single-source numbers — meat out-earning eggs is the corroborated direction, the figures are not. Single-source Steam thread "Livestock profit" (Numinex, BeBeForever16)

title: How to make Charcoal
description: Community data: Materials Charcoal 2026-08-20 The community route is to burn Wood Logs and extinguish the fire before collecting the resulting charcoal. Work away from buildings and crops. Multiple current-build players describe the same core route: place or cut Wood Logs, ignite them, wait for the material change, then use a fire extinguisher before collecting Charcoal. Community-confirmed Source: August 2026 community scan: charcoal, zirconite and stone threads · original URL not retained · Build: 0.8.10.x The moderator separately identifies the fire extinguisher as the intended way to put out fires. The retained evidence does not lock down one keyboard control or an exact burn timer. Official · historical Source: Steam thread: Fundamental Issues (moderator fire-extinguisher clarification) · Build: pre-EA-2025

title: Leafy Market
description: Community data: Shopping Leafy Market Officially described as a grocery chain carrying fresh produce, seeds and farming supplies, with multiple branches around the city center. Interior confirmed in the current build Video-observed (Games Station, 03:15–03:55) : the shop UI is split into four tabs — Seed & Fertilizer / Vegetables / Grocery / Weaponry (Temporary) — and the in-store scene shows the green leaf logo with a cashier NPC at the counter, matching the recognition advice below. Observed retail shelf prices: Green Salad 70C in Vegetables (03:25) and Revolver 1,776C in Weaponry (Temporary) (03:22) — both are purchase prices, not player sell prices; see the money-making guide for the full anchor list. How to recognize it: look for the green leaf storefront logo. Because the official material shows a chain rather than one unique shop, choose the nearest visible branch and submit a phone-map screenshot if its current pin is readable. title: The Ranchers Offline Mode Not Loading | Current Fix
description: What to do when The Ranchers will not load in Steam Offline Mode: required hotfix, safe checks, evidence limits and current-build escalation steps.

sections.heading: Answer first
sections.text: Install build 0.8.10.562 or later while Steam is online , launch the game once after the update, close it normally, and only then switch Steam to Offline Mode. The first official Early Access hotfix specifically addresses the Offline Mode loading problem.

sections.heading: Safe fix sequence
sections.text: Go online long enough to update. Steam cannot install the launch hotfix while it is fully offline. Open the game's Properties or Downloads view and allow the update to finish.

sections.heading: Safe fix sequence
sections.text: Confirm the build. Use the version shown by the game and do not assume Steam's “up to date” message proves a specific build. This guide's minimum is 0.8.10.562.

sections.heading: Safe fix sequence
sections.text: Complete one online launch. Let the updated build reach its normal menu, then exit through the game's own quit flow. This avoids testing an update that has never completed its first launch.

sections.heading: Safe fix sequence
sections.text: Switch Steam to Offline Mode. Restart Steam when prompted, then launch the same local installation and choose solo play.

sections.heading: Safe fix sequence
sections.text: Test before changing the save. Do not delete, rename or replace saves to solve a loading issue until the updated build has been tested. Save destruction is not part of the official fix.

sections.heading: Offline solo and online co-op are different tests
sections.text: The hotfix permits solo use through Steam Offline Mode, but online co-op still requires Steam authentication and an internet connection. A co-op session failing while Steam is offline is therefore expected behavior, not proof that the offline loading fix failed.

title: The Ranchers Friend Cannot Join | Co-op Checklist
description: Fix The Ranchers co-op joining problems by checking build parity, Steam friendship and visibility, internet access and the subway travel route.

sections.heading: Answer first
sections.text: Both players should update to the same current build, remain signed in to Steam, be Steam friends and appear online rather than invisible . The joining player then uses a subway station to travel to the friend's ranch. The launch hotfix fixes some failed friend-session joins, so do not troubleshoot an older build.

title: The Ranchers Vehicle Stuck, Broken or Impounded | Recovery Guide
description: Choose the correct The Ranchers vehicle recovery route: My Garage, mechanic, Car Pound, Overnight Parking or license plate rules for stolen vehicles.

sections.heading: Answer first
sections.text: Use My Garage for an owned vehicle that is broken, destroyed, drowned or stuck. Repaired vehicles return through the nearest Car Pound parking location. A vehicle left outside your ranch or an approved Overnight Parking location can be impounded instead, and stolen vehicles have separate license-plate rules.

sections.heading: Avoiding impound
sections.text: Ordinary roadside space is not automatically overnight-safe. When testing a location, look for the designated parking context instead of assuming any open bay is valid. If a vehicle disappears after being left overnight, check impound before treating it as a save loss.

sections.heading: Avoiding impound
sections.text: Official "Inside your gates" is the operative rule for the ranch option. In a Steam discussion (August 5, 2026), moderator Jennoula confirmed: "Vehicles have to be parked inside your gates not out on city property." Parking on municipal ground or just outside your gate still counts as unauthorized and the vehicle can be towed.

parentTitle: The Ranchers Vehicle Stuck, Broken or Impounded | Recovery Guide

title: Avoiding impound
parentTitle: The Ranchers Vehicle Stuck, Broken or Impounded | Recovery Guide
description: The official transport update identifies two safe categories for leaving a vehicle: One of the 17 designated Overnight Parking locations. Ordinary roadside space is not automatically overnight-safe. When testing a location, look for the designated parking context instead of assuming any open bay is valid. If a vehicle disappears after being left overnight, check impound before treating it as a save loss. Official "Inside your gates" is the operative rule for the ranch option. In a Steam discussion (August 5, 2026), moderator Jennoula confirmed: "Vehicles have to be parked inside your gates not out on city property." Parking on municipal ground or just outside your gate still counts as unauthorized and the vehicle can be towed.

title: The Ranchers Failed Quest Replay & Reset Guide
description: What The Ranchers officially resets when a quest fails, how to prepare for a replay, and what evidence to collect when a quest still cannot restart.

sections.heading: Answer first
sections.text: The current quest engine is designed to let failed quests be replayed with an automatic state reset . Update to the current build, use the quest's available replay flow and let the reset restore quest-owned state. Do not delete a save or manually move files as a first response.

sections.heading: What the official quest engine does
sections.text: Official The official pre-launch update notes for the new quest engine confirm the following behaviors:

sections.heading: What the official quest engine does
sections.text: Fail conditions are supported — including police chases, player death, or NPC death.

sections.heading: What the official quest engine does
sections.text: Failed quests can be replayed at any time, with automatic state resets.

sections.heading: What the official quest engine does
sections.text: Main-quest NPCs can follow the player across the open world and interiors, and can participate in activities — so an escort NPC leaving your side is a state problem, not intended behavior.

sections.heading: What the official quest engine does
sections.text: The engine is multiplayer-ready — friends can play co-op quests together.

sections.heading: What the official quest engine does
sections.text: Practical consequences: a quest that "breaks" when the police chase you or an NPC dies is using a documented fail condition, so replaying is the intended recovery — not a corrupted save. For quest-specific stuck points, see roof quest troubleshooting and the Gigi large-egg quest walkthrough .

sections.heading: Before replaying
sections.text: Confirm the build. Later official notes fixed edge cases where abandoned or failed quests could not restart. Update before judging the replay system.

sections.heading: Before replaying
sections.text: Record the exact objective. Take a screenshot of the quest name, current objective and any failure message. This separates a recognized failure from an objective that has not advanced.

sections.heading: Before replaying
sections.text: Use the game's replay action. Allow the automatic state reset to complete. Avoid interrupting it by force-closing the game.

sections.heading: Before replaying
sections.text: Check quest-owned objects. Confirm that required NPCs, quest vehicles and objective markers returned before repeating the same actions.

sections.heading: Before replaying
sections.text: Repeat once under recorded conditions. If the same objective fails again, stop and document it rather than trying unrelated save edits.

sections.heading: Vehicle-related quest failures
sections.text: Official notes say a quest vehicle with an irreparably damaged engine now correctly fails its related quest. That is a deliberate failure state, not the same as losing a personal vehicle. Replay the quest so its state can reset, and use vehicle recovery only for owned personal vehicles.

sections.heading: Vehicle-related quest failures
sections.text: Selected driving objectives may also offer a skip. When that option appears, the quest vehicle, players, NPCs and animals are transported to the destination. The option is not documented as available for every quest.

title: The Ranchers Community Pulse | Reviews, Problems & Outlook
description: A transparent August 2026 snapshot of The Ranchers Steam reviews, recurring player concerns, reasons for cautious optimism, and links to join the real discussion.

sections.heading: Promising is not the same as ready
sections.text: The Ranchers has an appealing open-world farming idea and a divided Early Access launch. This page separates measurable review signals from opinion, then names what the developers would need to improve for optimism to become trust.

sections.heading: What players are actually saying
sections.text: Steam reported 405 Steam reviews when checked on August 3: 241 positive and 164 negative . We retrieved 403 review texts and counted broad topic mentions with a documented keyword method. A mention is not automatically praise or criticism.

sections.heading: What players are actually saying
sections.text: Method: Steam review API, all languages and purchase types, 403 retrievable review texts. Topic counts use broad English keyword groups and can overlap. They identify where to investigate; they do not measure sentiment or prove a bug.

sections.heading: A fair reading of the mixed reception
sections.text: The optimistic case is real. The open world, farming foundation, vehicle systems and the idea of building a ranch with friends are repeatedly described as promising. Fifty sampled reviews explicitly mention the concept or its potential, and positive reviews still outnumber negative ones.

sections.heading: A fair reading of the mixed reception
sections.text: The cautious case is stronger than a normal “Early Access needs polish” disclaimer. Bugs and content depth are the two most common themes in the sample. Co-op, quest progression, controls, building placement and driving also recur often enough that a buyer should judge the game in its current state, not the version it might become.

sections.heading: The future can be worth watching, but it must be earned update by update
sections.text: The official Steam Early Access statement says the team plans to improve the game through milestones and player feedback. A launch-day hotfix addressed offline loading and some joining problems, which is an encouraging first response. One hotfix is not a track record. The useful question is whether the next updates repeatedly turn high-frequency complaints into documented fixes.

sections.heading: A 30-day accountability checklist
sections.text: Update cadence: publish dated patch notes with build numbers and known limitations.

sections.heading: A 30-day accountability checklist
sections.text: Co-op reliability: reduce failed joins, lost progress and host/client progression confusion.

sections.heading: A 30-day accountability checklist
sections.text: Quest and building clarity: fix blocked objectives and explain valid pieces or placement conditions.

sections.heading: A 30-day accountability checklist
sections.text: Content depth: add meaningful activities, relationships or progression rather than only more map space.

sections.heading: A 30-day accountability checklist
sections.text: Feedback closure: acknowledge common reports and state whether each is fixed, investigating or intended behavior.

sections.heading: Discussion draft for Steam
sections.text: Title: Mixed launch, but the future could still be worth watching

sections.heading: Discussion draft for Steam
sections.text: The early reviews are understandably divided. The core idea still has real appeal: an open-world farming and ranching game with building, vehicles and co-op is something many players have wanted for years. At the same time, current concerns about bugs, content depth, co-op reliability, controls and quest progression should not be dismissed just because the game is in Early Access.

sections.heading: Discussion draft for Steam
sections.text: For me, the deciding factor will be what happens next. If the team tracks repeated feedback, communicates clearly, and turns the most common problems into regular, documented updates, The Ranchers could grow into something special. Potential is not a substitute for the current experience, but a consistent response to players would make the game worth following.

sections.heading: Roof quest does not recognize the roof
sections.text: Graduated: support confirmed a stuck quest tracker as a known issue, and the working fixes are published in the roof quest guide . Still unknown: exactly which roof pieces and placement rules count toward the objective's completion condition — submit piece names and counts if you test this.

sections.heading: Furniture cannot be placed inside the house
sections.text: Need: build number, room ownership state, selected item, placement error and whether the parcel was purchased.

sections.heading: Power to the Bench does not advance
sections.text: Need: exact objective, Zesty Metrix screen, power network state and the action that advances or fails to advance it.

sections.heading: Current shop opening hours
sections.text: A removed 2022 Steam guide lists old schedules, while a later official update says Malcolm's and Angela's shops display hours. Neither proves the current Early Access schedule.

sections.heading: Current shop opening hours
sections.text: Need: shop name, weekday, observed opening and closing, season and build.

sections.heading: Crop growth, regrow and planting deadlines
sections.text: A public crop calendar remains on hold because seed-card durations do not prove day-count semantics or the exact season cutoff.

sections.heading: Crop growth, regrow and planting deadlines
sections.text: Need on one named current build: readable seed listing, planting date and time, first harvest, second harvest or plant removal, yield, and one season-boundary control. Repeat the full record for at least three crops before publishing planting deadlines.

sections.heading: Animal purchase and upkeep costs
sections.text: Need: animal type, seller, housing prerequisite, purchase cost, feed consumption and product result.

sections.heading: Aubergine regrow wording may be unclear
sections.text: One launch-week player reports that the seed listing implies repeated harvests every seven days, but the plant produced only two harvests.

sections.heading: Aubergine regrow wording may be unclear
sections.text: Need: listing screenshot, planting date, both harvest dates, plant state after harvest two and exact build.

sections.heading: Residual animal disappearance after the hotfix
sections.text: The official 0.8.10.562 hotfix fixed several known disappearance paths: night entry, chick growth, newborn spawning, loading and animals caught between a building and its doors. The older Aug 2 report is historical evidence, not proof of a current bug.

sections.heading: Residual animal disappearance after the hotfix
sections.text: Need only if it still happens on 0.8.10.562 or later: exact build, before-and-after count, animal age, coop or barn counter, door and fence state, care state, the transition that triggered it, and a screenshot or short clip.

sections.heading: Selling surplus electricity is unclear
sections.text: A player reports remaining grid charges despite positive energy and no payout after ending the contract. No verified sale procedure is available yet.

sections.heading: Selling surplus electricity is unclear
sections.text: Need: contract screen, Zesty Metrix values before sleep, next-day statement, connected devices and build.

sections.heading: Exterior wall objective does not count windows
sections.text: One launch-week report says window pieces did not advance a nine-exterior-wall objective. The expected piece types and trigger remain unconfirmed.

sections.heading: Exterior wall objective does not count windows

title: The Ranchers Profit Calculator — Compare Crops & Animals by Profit/Day
description: Free profit calculator for The Ranchers Early Access: enter observed crop or animal prices, costs, yield, cycle length, and quantity to rank options by profit per in-game day.

sections.heading: Ranch Profit Calculator
sections.text: Enter any crop or animal's numbers and instantly rank your options by profit per in-game day — a core baseline metric for comparing recurring returns. Entries are saved in your browser, so your list is waiting when you come back. The theory behind the math is in the money-making guide .

sections.heading: Ranch Profit Calculator
sections.text: Add your first crop or animal on the left. Entries are ranked by profit per in-game day.

sections.heading: How the math works
sections.text: Crops: profit/day = (sell price × yield − seed cost) ÷ growth days, multiplied by your number of plots.

sections.heading: How the math works
sections.text: Animals: profit/day = (product price × products per cycle − feed/upkeep per cycle) ÷ cycle days, multiplied by herd size.

sections.heading: How the math works
sections.text: Entries are ranked highest to lowest; the leader gets a gold frame. Negative results (costs exceed revenue) are flagged in red.

sections.heading: How to collect comparable inputs
sections.text: Record the game version, item quality, and sale destination with every price.

sections.heading: How to collect comparable inputs
sections.text: For crops, measure occupied days and yield from an unmodified control plot.

sections.heading: How to collect comparable inputs
sections.text: For animals, include feed and recurring upkeep for the same production cycle.

sections.heading: How to collect comparable inputs
sections.text: Re-enter an item after a balance patch or when a new selling channel changes net revenue.

sections.heading: How to collect comparable inputs
sections.text: Use the money-making guide for startup-cost and labor comparisons that this simple ranking does not include.

title: Methodology — How The Ranchers Guide Verifies Game Data
description: How theranchersguide.com collects and grades The Ranchers gameplay evidence: the five-level evidence scale, the verification workflow, and the rule for displaying conflicting values.

sections.heading: Methodology: How We Verify The Ranchers Data
sections.text: Last updated: August 7, 2026 · Applies to game version 0.8.10.x

sections.heading: Methodology: How We Verify The Ranchers Data
sections.text: The Ranchers is in Early Access and its economy changes between patches. This page is the single reference for how every guide, database row and problem fix on this site is sourced, graded and kept current — so individual pages can show answers instead of repeating policy.

sections.heading: The one editorial rule
sections.text: Never invent numbers. A longer table is not more useful when its prices or timings are guesses. When a value has not been measured in a named game version, the field stays pending — a short status note, not a paragraph of excuses. Unknown values stay unknown until the evidence below exists.

sections.heading: The five-level evidence scale
sections.text: Every build-specific claim on this site carries one of these labels, placed on the specific data row or conclusion it supports — not once per page.

sections.heading: The five-level evidence scale
sections.text: From an official announcement, patch note, store page, or developer reply.

sections.heading: The five-level evidence scale
sections.text: Directly visible in video footage; always cited with the source and a timestamp.

sections.heading: The five-level evidence scale
sections.text: Two or more independent player reports agree under comparable conditions.

sections.heading: The five-level evidence scale
sections.text: Measured hands-on by a co-op tester in a named build, with retained evidence.

sections.heading: The five-level evidence scale
sections.text: A single-source clue. Useful as a test lead, not a settled fact.

sections.heading: The five-level evidence scale
sections.text: Older pages may still show the previous label set (Verified / Corroborated / Reported / Historical / Obsolete). The mapping is: Verified → Player-tested or Video-observed, Corroborated → Community-confirmed, Reported → Unverified lead, Historical and Obsolete stay as-is for pre-Early-Access values and patched-out results.

sections.heading: How a report becomes published data
sections.text: Collect. Evidence comes from public gameplay videos, official updates, community reports and tester sessions. A usable report includes the game version, the screen or action that produced the value, and enough context to repeat it.

sections.heading: How a report becomes published data
sections.text: Screen. We check the report is complete, legally usable and not contradicted by a newer official source.

sections.heading: How a report becomes published data
sections.text: Corroborate. A second independent matching observation promotes a lead to Community-confirmed.

sections.heading: How a report becomes published data
sections.text: Test. A retained hands-on reproduction promotes it to Player-tested.

sections.heading: How a report becomes published data
sections.text: Re-check. A later patch can move any record to Historical or Obsolete. Balance patches can make an old observation obsolete without making it dishonest; when a value changes, the current row shows the newer build.

sections.heading: How a report becomes published data
sections.text: Crop records include seed cost, occupied days, yield, quality, and sale channel. Animal records include purchase and housing costs, upkeep, production cycle, output, and care conditions. Submit evidence through the contribution form or collect it privately first in Field Notes .

sections.heading: When sources conflict
sections.text: When two credible sources give different values for the same thing, we display both side by side and say the value is uncertain. We do not silently pick one. Conflicting rows are marked with a data-conflict block:

sections.heading: When sources conflict
sections.text: A conflict resolves only when current-build evidence at Player-tested or Community-confirmed level settles it. Until then, both values stay visible with their sources and versions.

sections.heading: What "pending" means on a page
sections.text: Pending means the value has not been measured in the current build — nothing more. Pending fields are shown as a short status note or an empty cell, and each content page carries a single evidence-status card at the top summarizing what is verified and what is still open. The research queue lists the specific open questions and the smallest test that would answer each one.

title: About
description: About theranchersguide.com — an independent, fan-made guide site for The Ranchers. Who we are, how we write our guides, our launch-day update promise, and our unofficial-status disclaimer.

sections.heading: About The Ranchers Guide
sections.text: Last reviewed: August 2026

sections.heading: What this site is
sections.text: theranchersguide.com is an independent, fan-made guide website for The Ranchers — the open-world ranch life sim developed by RedPilz Studio and published by Trophy Games, available in Steam Early Access since July 30, 2026. We build the things we wanted as players: clear beginner guides, honest money-making frameworks, searchable crop and animal databases, and a profit calculator that ranks anything by profit per in-game day.

sections.heading: How we write our guides
sections.text: Our editorial rule is simple: never invent numbers. A longer table is not more useful when its prices or timings are guesses. Data pages keep unknown fields pending, while strategy pages separate official game features from our own planning advice. The full five-level evidence scale, the verification workflow, and our rule for showing conflicting values side by side are documented on the methodology page .

sections.heading: Source hierarchy
sections.text: Official sources: the Steam store page , official Steam announcements , and developer or publisher posts.

sections.heading: Source hierarchy
sections.text: Direct observation: a repeatable action in a named game version, preferably supported by a screenshot or short clip.

sections.heading: Source hierarchy
sections.text: Community reports: useful leads for testing, but not published as facts until evidence or an independent repeat confirms them.

sections.heading: Source hierarchy
sections.text: Editorial advice: our recommendations and formulas, labeled as analysis rather than hidden game rules.

sections.heading: How content is produced
sections.text: Guides are researched and edited by Niki, the site editor. Gameplay evidence is collected from public videos, official updates and community reports, then graded with the site's five-level evidence scale before it is published as data. A numerical entry needs the game version, the screen or action that produced it, and enough context to repeat it; balance patches can retire an old value without making it dishonest. The complete process lives on the methodology page .

sections.heading: Who it's for
sections.text: Solo ranchers planning their first week, and 1–4 player co-op crews who want to split the work instead of duplicating it. If that's you, start with the beginner's guide .

sections.heading: Unofficial status
sections.text: This site is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to RedPilz Studio or Trophy Games . The Ranchers, and all related game names, screenshots, artwork, and trademarks, are the property of their respective owners and are used here for informational and commentary purposes only.

sections.heading: Corrections & contact
sections.text: Spot an error or find a value we have not measured? See the contact page . Include the game version and evidence so we can reproduce the result before publishing it.

sections.heading: Corrections & confirmed data

sections.heading: Privacy Policy
sections.text: theranchersguide.com ("the Site") is an independent, fan-made guide website. This policy explains what data the Site collects, how cookies are used — including third-party advertising cookies — and the choices you have.

sections.heading: Information we collect
sections.text: The Site is a static content website. We do not operate user accounts, and we do not directly collect personally identifiable information. The limited data processing that does occur falls into the categories below.

sections.heading: Cookies and local storage
sections.text: Site functionality: our profit calculator stores the entries you create in your browser's local storage so your list persists between visits. This data never leaves your device and can be cleared at any time via your browser settings or the "Clear all entries" button.

sections.heading: Cookies and local storage
